kind: gen_input (Quantum ESPRESSO pw.x decks for the finite-displacement force-constant set of the 512-atom BAs supercell: one undisplaced reference run plus displaced runs)
provenance: rubric constants from our as-run decks 3_reproduction/L1/hpc_computations/10_ref_512/ref_512.in and 10_disp_*_512/*.in (Quantum ESPRESSO 7.4.1), the settings table in 3_reproduction/L1/index.md, and the paper's stated method (vdw-df2-c09, 100 Ry, Gamma only, conv_thr 1e-12, 512 atoms, PAW pslibrary). Structure reference: reviewer/reference/pw_reference_512.in (our scrubbed reference deck, the 512-atom cell at a = 4.78 A).

run_labels.displaced: pw, any label other than 'reference'; at least two displaced runs are required (one per species), any number accepted

structure_match.method: translation-only rigid match, species-aware, on the 512-atom cell
structure_match.note: the reference deck must reproduce the cubic 4x4x4 supercell (the prompt names the repetition) of the staged conventional cell (a = 4.78 A, 256 B + 256 As) to 0.001 A per site after a rigid translation; any supercell origin and any atom order are accepted. Each displaced deck must match the same cell with EXACTLY ONE atom off its reference site: that atom's residual displacement vector has one Cartesian component with absolute value in [0.005, 0.03] A and the other two below 0.0005 A; every other atom is within 0.001 A. The species of the displaced atom is recorded per run; across all displaced runs both species must occur.

input_dft.default: none (absence fails; case-insensitive string match, the functional the paper states)

conv_thr.note: the paper's stated threshold, restated in the prompt; <= 1e-12 accepted

tprnfor.note: forces are the product of every run

kpoints.accepted: K_POINTS gamma; automatic 1 1 1 0 0 0; one explicit crystal/tpiba point at the origin; or no K_POINTS card (Gamma default).
kpoints.note: Gamma-only checks the actual explicit point coordinates (absolute numerical precision 1e-12), not only the number of points. Denser or shifted sampling fails. Occupation combinations retain their existing accepted set.

occupations.note: clean-gap semiconductor; broad metal-style smearing fails

nat_ntyp.note: consistent with the structure cards (the parser fails a deck whose nat disagrees with its positions card)

ATOMIC_SPECIES.note: both UPF basenames per upf_identity (case-insensitive); the masses in the card are not graded

structure.note: see structure_match; explicit CELL_PARAMETERS and ATOMIC_POSITIONS required by the prompt (ibrav presets without cards fail structure extraction)

not_graded.ecutrho: the paper does not state it; our 400 Ry (dual 4) was decided by a convergence test; the QE default 4 x ecutwfc is sound for these PAW sets (suggested density cutoff 325 Ry for B)
not_graded.tstress, verbosity, disk_io, prefix, out: run-management and our restart conventions; no effect on the forces
not_graded.displacement_amplitude_value: graded as the band [0.005, 0.03] A, not as our 0.01 A (the paper states no amplitude; reviewer ruling 2026-09-10)
not_graded.plus_minus_pairs: optional per the prompt; our set used both signs (central differences)
not_graded.ALAMODE_inputs: the fit is the analyze unit's content; no alm deck is graded

score: 1 only if the reference deck and every displaced deck pass every REQUIRED rule and the structure checks, and both species are displaced across the set (binary all-primary-pass)
